basic_info.description: This desirable Junior 1 bedroom home at One Hawthorne offers an ideal floor plan in a city center location with complete access to premium building amenities and services. Residence #6F features a selection of refined, modern finishes, including hardwood floors in an open-plan living/dining room with incredible natural light via an expansive wall of windows. Open to the living area is a designer-inspired kitchen from Studio Becker that includes ample custom cabinetry, a tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Adjacent to the living area is the spacious sleeping area with a large closet. Window shades, central A/C, and a washer/dryer are also included. One Hawthorne is a landmark condominium community offering centralized access to Union Square shopping, high end dining, and world-class entertainment; plus the Financial District, Yerba Buena Gardens, Embarcadero, the SF MoMa, and all major tech headquarters. Residents enjoy access to an attended lobby; rooftop deck; and a fitness center with an outdoor cooling terrace. Convenient transportation options via the Salesforce Transit Center, Caltrain, BART, and Muni connect you to major local and regional transportation, assuring an easy commute to virtually anywhere in the Bay Area.
